source.assertion: setTrinket(team,unitId,type) supports free, owner-validated fountain switch
item.buy dispatches Arena.buy; item.queue dispatches queuePurchase; no use of purchaseOrPlan or setTrinket

consequences: Single-player/internal Arena APIs allow trinket swaps, but the authoritative PvP command vocabulary does not.
Sending item.buy trinket_oracle is rejected via canBuy (not purchasable as normal inventory).
Sending item.queue trinket_oracle is rejected at queuePurchase.
Sending item.trinket is not in accepted command kind set.
The 122 engine_playable SR labels therefore describe internal playability, not necessarily player-remote reachability.

migration_contract.fix_policy: Record as explicit parity deviation: Rust PvP must expose validated item.trinket action at user-authorized source, subject to owner/team and fountain reach, NOT silently hardcode 122 buyables.
require_authority: canonical legacy source mapping itemId to trinket state
do not reset cooldown via switch
do not expose enemy inventory/trinket private state
